name: blog
//: Read the comment in .devcontainer/Dockerfile first. Containment here is a function of what is NOT mounted and NOT installed, so the mount list below is deliberately short. Before adding a mount, ask: does this need to be writable, does it carry a credential, and is there a path that does not require it? Adding a mount here is a security decision, not a convenience one.
//mounts-why: Eight mounts, and each is deliberate. (1) the repo-scoped PAT, at the same relative path it has on the host so git-askpass.sh needs no container variant. NOT the ~/.config/jef directory, which holds every other repo's PAT. (2) the spend-cap script, (3) agent-kit's instructions/ (at the old ~/tools/llm-instructions path) and (4) its worker skills where pi looks for them, all read-only so the agent cannot edit the rules it runs under. (5) this repo's outbox new/, the only writable mount besides the workspace: notify-jef drops a message there and the host's agentd validates, rate-limits and mails it (agentd I5). (6) ~/tools/bin-container, read-only and on PATH, for notify-jef. (7) the wiki, read-only. (8) the lab-bot's spend-capped OpenRouter key, for pi and for scripts/hero.py (hero_gen/openrouter.py reads ~/.pi/agent/auth.json), not a personal one. NOT ~/.ssh, NOT the rest of ~/.config/lab-bot, NOT ~/.aws or ~/.azure, NOT the rest of ~/tools, NOT the docker socket.
//initializeCommand: Runs on the HOST before the container starts. Creates this repo's outbox dirs so Docker does not create the bind source root-owned, and an empty placeholder PAT file (mode 600) so the mount works before the real token is saved; git push fails cleanly until it is. The project name is the directory basename, as agentd tags it (I4).
//postStartCommand: Links the global instructions into place for pi. The link points into the read-only directory mount, not a single-file bind, which would pin the inode and go stale when the host file is edited.
//runArgs: Port 1111 is published on the host's loopback only, for the zola serve preview (run it with --interface 0.0.0.0 inside; see notes/post-workflow.md). It is the only port: Zola 0.23 serves live-reload on the same one. While this container runs, a host-side zola serve needs another port.
//features: No docker-in-docker: the site is a zola build, nothing else.

remoteEnv.//git: GIT_ASKPASS points at the tracked script that reads the mounted PAT. GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 stops a failed lookup from falling back to an interactive prompt, which hangs an unattended run. GIT_SSH_COMMAND=/bin/false backs up the missing ssh binary.

//customizations: No postCreateCommand: zola is a single binary and the scripts are PEP 723, so there is nothing to provision. Commit identity comes from the repo-local git config.
